intent.proves: At least one customer number is carried by two or more active default-type users.
intent.scope: active AccessUser rows of type Default (5) with a non-empty customer number; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Lookup by known customer numbers only; a census of shared numbers needs an enumeration handler.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AccessUserCustomerNumber FROM AccessUser WHERE AccessUserType = 5 AND AccessUserActive = 1 AND ISNULL(AccessUserCustomerNumber,'') <> '' GROUP BY AccessUserCustomerNumber HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) x
